access.zh: API 与 Claude 订阅；权重不开源。
access.en: API and Claude subscription; weights are not open.

generations.zh: 5.2 两档：Fable 5.2 带网络安全/生物安全护栏，Mythos 5.2 仅限验证机构；同底座，官方模型页列 1M 上下文 / 128K 输出。
generations.en: Two 5.2 tiers: Fable 5.2 carries cyber/bio safeguards; Mythos 5.2 is limited to verified organizations. Same underlying model; official model pages list 1M context / 128K output.

generations.zh: 当前代：官方模型总览列 Fable 5.1 / Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 / Haiku 5.5，全部 1M 上下文 / 128K 最大输出，知识截点 2026-06；官方页同时给出「退役不早于」日期（2027-09/10）。
generations.en: Current generation: the official model overview lists Fable 5.1 / Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 / Haiku 5.5, all 1M context / 128K max output, knowledge cutoff Jun 2026; the same page lists retirement dates (no sooner than Sep/Oct 2027).

generations.zh: 上一代：Fable 5 于 2026-06-09 全面可用（官方平台文档），Sonnet 5 于 2026-06-30 发布（官方产品页）。
generations.en: Previous step: Fable 5 became generally available June 9, 2026 (official platform docs); Sonnet 5 launched June 30, 2026 (official product page).

v.en: 1M tokens (official model pages for Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2)

v.zh: 按档位与用量计费，本站不抄具体数字；以官方模型页或发布页的定价表为准。
v.en: Billed by tier and usage; this site does not copy numbers — see the official pricing table.

v.zh: 5.2 比 5.1 输出更快（官方称最多 30%），并下调了定价；Fable 与 Mythos 同底座，Fable 带网络安全/生物安全护栏，Mythos 仅限验证机构（官方发布页）。
v.en: 5.2 generates up to 30% faster than 5.1 and lowers pricing; Fable and Mythos share one underlying model, with Fable carrying cyber/bio safeguards and Mythos limited to verified organizations (official announcement).

positioning.zh: 闭源旗舰线（agentic 编码与企业向）：官方模型总览是规格真相源；官方文档将模型 ID 定义为固定版本，而非持续更新的别名；选型时应核对具体 ID。
positioning.en: A closed flagship line (agentic coding and enterprise): the official model overview is the spec source of truth; model IDs are pinned snapshots, not evergreen pointers (stated in official docs) — match versions by ID.

onSite.zh: 权重不开源，这里无量化对比；编码工具形态的 Claude Code / Claude 档案在 AI 工具站。
onSite.en: No open weights, so no quantisation coverage here; the Claude Code / Claude product forms are carded on the tools site.
